words.example: I added an escalation note because the badge has been delayed four days.
words.exampleZh: 工牌已经耽误了四天，我补了一份升级说明。

words.example: A courtesy reminder about the missing quote went out to the vendor.
words.exampleZh: 关于报价还没到的礼貌催办，已经发给供应商了。

words.example: Send one chaser if the signed form has not come back by noon.
words.exampleZh: 如果签好的表格到中午还没回来，就发一封催办邮件。

words.example: One nudge email is enough; a formal letter can wait.
words.exampleZh: 一封轻催邮件就够了，正式函件可以再等等。

words.example: I will place a follow-up call if we have no vendor reply by noon.
words.exampleZh: 如果到中午供应商还没回复，我会打一个跟进电话。

words.example: The software audit found dictation installed on PCs that were never in the contract.
words.exampleZh: 软件审计发现，听写软件装在了合同里从未列入的电脑上。

words.example: An unlicensed install of the viewer showed up on a PC in clinic storage.
words.exampleZh: 门诊库房的一台电脑上出现了阅片程序的未授权安装。

words.example: The silent install of the viewer finished overnight and no one had to click through.
words.exampleZh: 阅片程序的静默安装在夜里完成了，没有人需要一路点下去。

words.example: The push install reached the reading room PCs but skipped two that were offline.
words.exampleZh: 推送安装到了读片室电脑，但跳过了两台不在线的。

words.example: Uninstall the retired viewer from clinic PCs before the new one is pushed.
words.exampleZh: 新阅片程序推下去之前，先把退役版本从门诊电脑上卸载。
